name: external5.k
model:
class StringMethodTests {
  parsed:Int

  req parsed = java.lang.Integer.parseInt("42")

  req parsed = 42
  parsedDouble:Real

  req parsedDouble = java.lang.Double.parseDouble("3.14159")

  req parsedDouble > 3.14E0

  req parsedDouble < 3.15E0
}

main:StringMethodTests
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((StringMethodTests (mk-StringMethodTests (parsed Int)(parsedDouble Real)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-StringMethodTests (sel-StringMethodTests StringMethodTests))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-StringMethodTests ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-StringMethodTests (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-StringMethodTests ((this Ref)) StringMethodTests
  (sel-StringMethodTests (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-StringMethodTests ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-StringMethodTests this)
)

; =======================================
; === External Function Declarations: ===
; =======================================

; Uninterpreted functions for external (Java) calls
(declare-fun java_lang_Integer_parseInt (Real) Real)
(declare-fun java_lang_Double_parseDouble (Real) Real)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ----------------------------------------
;   Getters for class StringMethodTests:
; ----------------------------------------

; --- getters for StringMethodTests.parsed: ---

(define-fun StringMethodTests!parsed ((this Ref)) Int
  (parsed (deref-StringMethodTests this))
)

; --- getters for StringMethodTests.parsedDouble: ---

(define-fun StringMethodTests!parsedDouble ((this Ref)) Real
  (parsedDouble (deref-StringMethodTests this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-StringMethodTests (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; ------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class StringMethodTests:
; ------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-StringMethodTests StringMethodTests)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun StringMethodTests.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringMethodTests!parsed this) (java_lang_Integer_parseInt "42"))
)

(assert (! (StringMethodTests.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun StringMethodTests.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringMethodTests!parsed this) 42)
)

(assert (! (StringMethodTests.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun StringMethodTests.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (StringMethodTests!parsedDouble this) (java_lang_Double_parseDouble "3.14159"))
)

(assert (! (StringMethodTests.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun StringMethodTests.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (StringMethodTests!parsedDouble this) 3.1400000000000000)
)

(assert (! (StringMethodTests.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun StringMethodTests.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (< (StringMethodTests!parsedDouble this) 3.1500000000000000)
)

(assert (! (StringMethodTests.inv5 1) :named _xkassert5))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-StringMethodTests const-1-StringMethodTests))
  )
)
